BiblicalUsage: The word for servant covers a slave, a hired worker, a subject of the king, and a worshipper of God, and the Bible uses the same word for all of them. Samuel answers the Lord's call with the words of a servant ready to hear, and the prophets are called God's servants because they belong to Him and do His bidding. In Isaiah the Servant is the chosen one on whom God puts His Spirit, the figure who carries God's work to the nations.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that serving God is the highest calling a person can have, not the lowest. The Bible never treats God's servants as disposable labour; it treats them as His own household, honoured and kept. That is why I would rather be called His servant than anything else the world offers.
